chambers.name: Warm Crack
chambers.objective: Move the nearby crate onto the plate to hold the short root gate open.
chambers.solution: The crate starts on the entrance side. Plate and gate latch after reward collection; opening never removes the exit.

chambers.name: Moss Pocket
chambers.objective: Move the nearby crate onto the plate to hold the short root gate open.

chambers.name: Pale Alcove
chambers.objective: Explore the visible warm crack and find the alcove reward.
chambers.solution: No ability gate. A breakable foreground veil may signal the secret but does not replace a real entrance or hide the return route.

chambers.name: Root Gallery
chambers.objective: Use three close thread anchors above a low gap to reach the upper niche.
chambers.solution: Every attachment is within 3.2 u from a designed launch ledge. Add a safe catch floor at y=-1; a fall returns to the entrance, not to a softlock.

chambers.name: High Crevice
chambers.objective: Climb the moss-marked shaft to the upper alcove and descend on permanent steps.
chambers.solution: Climbing Moss is the intended prerequisite. Shaft width 5 u; measured player wall jumps must reach both walls. Return has a safe floor and no locked door.

chambers.name: Hanging Garden
chambers.objective: Glide from the high launch shelf to a broad lower landing, then return by the root stair.
chambers.solution: Glidecap is the intended prerequisite. Horizontal gap 8 u, drop 7 u; add permanent 1.2 u-rise return steps along the rear wall and safe floor at y=0. Validate actual air control.

chambers.name: Underarch Workshop
chambers.objective: Open the root gate from the entrance side and speak to the trapped resident.
chambers.solution: The lever is reachable without late relics or a specific weapon. After rescue, persist the resident flag and activate the matching Qvale home/service. Never award twice.

chambers.name: Silt Cistern
chambers.objective: Use the sluice lever to expose a dry lower shelf, retrieve the find, then return on permanent steps.
chambers.solution: Lever is available before the water. Steps stay usable in either water state; no timed swimming or unimplemented swimming ability is required.
